Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package set1;

public class FindTriplets {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		System.out.print("Enter the size of array : ");
		int[] arr = new int[Helper.getPosInt()];
		System.out.println("Enter elements : ");
		for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
			arr[i] = Helper.getInt();
		}
		printTriplets(arr);
	}

	private static void printTriplets(int[] arr) {
		for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
			int key1 = arr[i];
			for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
				int key2 = arr[j];
				int sum = key1 + key2;
				for (int k = j + 1; k < arr.length; k++) {
					if (arr[k] == sum)
						System.out.println("<" + key1 + "," + key2 + "," + sum + ">");
				}
			}
		}
	}

}
